pois.label: 发动机舱（6×猛禽）
pois.detail: 上面级尾裙集成 6 台猛禽全流量分级燃烧发动机：内圈 3 台海平面版（可万向摆动，负责姿态与着陆）+ 外圈 3 台真空版（大膨胀比喷管，负责巡航加速）。着陆时仅点海平面机。承力锥把推力传入箱体裙段，周围布 COPV 高压气瓶与 LOX 集液槽。
sim: L1 手算：6 台全开 13.8 MN，火表起飞质量 ~1420 t，重量 5.27 MN → 起飞 T/W=2.6（健康）
着陆仅点海平面机，且推力过剩是主要矛盾：单台深节流到 40% 时 T/W 仍 >1，无法悬停，只能连续减速直接触地（详见着陆头罐卡 L2）
L2 羽流分析（见 scripts/sim_plume_veh_rocket_01.py）：着陆最后 ~180 m 自激扬尘、~23 m 以下裸土挖坑，触地坪面载荷 ~1.4 MPa → 必须烧结硬化坪；喷砂射程数百米~3km，已迁入专用发射回收场 ops-spaceport-01（烧结坪+防爆土堤，场站设计经本羽流分析独立验证）
pois.detail_en: The upper-stage aft skirt integrates six Raptor full-flow staged-combustion engines: an inner ring of 3 sea-level engines (gimbaled, handling attitude and landing) and an outer ring of 3 vacuum engines with high-expansion nozzles for cruise acceleration. Only the sea-level engines light for landing. A thrust cone carries loads into the tank skirt, surrounded by COPV pressure bottles and a LOX sump.
sim_en: L1 hand check: all six at full thrust give 13.8 MN against ~1420 t Mars liftoff mass (5.27 MN weight) -> liftoff T/W = 2.6 (healthy)

Landing lights the sea-level engines only, and surplus thrust is the core problem: one engine deep-throttled to 40% still holds T/W > 1, so no hover - only a continuous deceleration straight to touchdown (see the header-tank card, L2)

L2 plume analysis (scripts/sim_plume_veh_rocket_01.py): self-induced dust from ~180 m up, cratering of bare soil below ~23 m, ~1.4 MPa pad load at touchdown -> the pad must be sinter-hardened; sandblast reach spans hundreds of meters to 3 km, hence the move to the dedicated launch/recovery site ops-spaceport-01 (whose layout this plume analysis independently validated)

pois.label: 主推进剂罐（LOX/CH₄ 共底）
pois.detail: 下段 LOX 主罐、上段 CH₄ 主罐，中间共底相接以省质量。CH₄ 通过中轴下输管穿越 LOX 罐直达推力结构——星舰最具辨识度的内部特征。罐内环向加强筋 + 中部防晃挡板抑制晃动载荷，封头设检修人孔。

specs.布局: LOX 下 / CH₄ 上，共底
specs.下输管: 中轴甲烷管穿 LOX 罐

sim: L1 手算：满箱 + 120 t 干重，空载 Δv=8.8 km/s；带 ~100 t 返回载荷 Δv=6.9 km/s 恰闭合火表→地球转移（TEI）
L2 轨迹仿真（2-DOF RK4，见 scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_01.py）：火表→200km 圆轨真实 Δv=4.02 km/s，引力损失 274 + 阻力 34 m/s，比 L1 理想 3.9 偏乐观 ~3%；升轨仅用 ~380t（满箱 1/3），余量留 TEI
L2 洞察：max-Q 仅 6 kPa（地球 ~30-40 kPa），火星稀薄大气允许低平省Δv弹道、阻力几可忽略
返回任务账本（见 scripts/sim_mission_veh_rocket_01.py）：火表→低火轨→地球转移(TEI) 总 Δv 6.43 km/s（升轨4.02+TEI2.23+储备），满箱 1200t 带 133t 返回，与交接文档 100~150t 一致
ISRU 耦合：本地加满 1200 t 需 res-isru-01（0.062 t/sol）×40 台并联 / ~1.6 MWe 才能赶单个发射窗口，电力尺度跳到 pwr-fusion 级（详见 EQUIPMENT.md §9）
pois.detail_en: LOX main tank below, CH4 main tank above, joined by a common dome to save mass. The methane downcomer runs down the axis straight through the LOX tank to the thrust structure - Starship's most recognizable internal feature. Ring stiffeners and a mid-tank slosh baffle tame slosh loads; the domes carry service manholes.

specs_en.Layout: LOX below / CH4 above, common dome
specs_en.Downcomer: axial CH4 line through the LOX tank

sim_en: L1 hand check: full tanks + 120 t dry mass give dv = 8.8 km/s empty; with ~100 t return payload dv = 6.9 km/s - just closing the Mars-to-Earth transfer (TEI)

L2 ascent sim (2-DOF RK4, scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_01.py): Mars surface to a 200 km circular orbit costs a true dv of 4.02 km/s (gravity loss 274 + drag 34 m/s), ~3% above the L1 ideal 3.9; ascent burns only ~380 t (a third of the tanks), the rest reserved for TEI
L2 insight: max-Q is only 6 kPa (vs ~30-40 kPa on Earth) - the thin atmosphere allows a low, flat, dv-saving trajectory with nearly negligible drag

Return-mission ledger (scripts/sim_mission_veh_rocket_01.py): surface -> low Mars orbit -> TEI totals dv 6.43 km/s (ascent 4.02 + TEI 2.23 + reserve); 1200 t of propellant carries 133 t home, consistent with the 100-150 t handover figure

ISRU coupling: refilling 1200 t locally takes res-isru-01 (0.062 t/sol) x40 units in parallel / ~1.6 MWe to make a single launch window - the power scale jumps to pwr-fusion class (EQUIPMENT.md sec. 9)

pois.label: 着陆头罐
pois.detail: 鼻锥内 LOX 头罐 + 共底上方 CH₄ 头罐,专供着陆点火。与主罐分离,保证着陆翻转机动时推进剂不晃散、进气口不吸气。头罐配增压小气瓶,沿向风面内壁双路管线下引到发动机舱。
sim: L1 手算：到达质量 ~240 t，着陆反推 Δv 0.6~0.8 km/s（火星稀薄大气气动减速有限）→ 需 49~67 t，与头罐容量量级吻合
L2 着陆仿真（1-DOF RK4，见 scripts/sim_descent_veh_rocket_01.py）：反推 Δv ~470 m/s、软触地 <2 m/s；再入/翻转仿真闭链后基线修正为终端 400 m/s、4 km 点火 → 全程 ~38 t，头罐 50 t 装填余 24%
L2 洞察：推力严重过剩——单台猛禽满推 T/W=2.8，最小节流 40% 单台 T/W 仍=1.13，火星上无法悬停，只能连续减速直接触地
头罐独立于主罐：着陆翻转 3~5 g 侧向机动下防止主罐晃空、进气口吸气
pois.detail_en: A LOX header in the nosecone plus a CH4 header above the common dome, dedicated to the landing burn. Separated from the main tanks so the flip maneuver cannot slosh propellant off the intakes. Each header carries its own pressurant bottle; twin feed lines run down the windward wall to the engine bay.
sim_en: L1 hand check: ~240 t arrival mass and a 0.6-0.8 km/s landing burn (thin air, limited aerobraking) need 49-67 t - matching the header capacity class

L2 landing sim (1-DOF RK4, scripts/sim_descent_veh_rocket_01.py): braking dv ~470 m/s, touchdown <2 m/s; after closing the entry/flip chain the baseline became terminal 400 m/s with ignition at 4 km -> ~38 t total, 24% margin in a 50 t header

L2 insight: thrust is grossly surplus - one Raptor at full power gives T/W = 2.8, and even at the 40% throttle floor a single engine still holds T/W = 1.13: no hovering on Mars, only continuous deceleration to touchdown
Headers separate from mains: keep propellant settled and intakes wet through the 3-5 g lateral flip maneuver

pois.label: 气动翼面（前×2 / 后×2）
pois.detail: 四片体襟翼铰接在向风面两侧：一对前翼（近鼻锥）+ 一对后翼（近尾裙）。再入时按“肚皮朝下”水平落体姿态,靠四翼差动调整配平与滚转,末端翻转竖直点火着陆。当前为着陆状态,翼面微下垂。铰线有整流罩。

specs.作用: 再入配平 + 姿态控制

sim: L2 再入走廊（2-DOF 升力体，见 scripts/sim_entry_veh_rocket_01.py）：直接再入 5.7 km/s，可行入射角仅 [-13°,-12°]（浅则跳出、陡则超 5 g₀）——火星走廊远陡于地球；标称 -13° 峰值 4.9 g₀、驻点热流 376 kW/m²（防热瓦载荷依据）
L2 翻转机动（3-DOF 俯仰 + TVC 闭环，见 scripts/sim_flip_veh_rocket_01.py）：85°→竖直 3.6 s、掉高 1.4 km、横移 379 m → 点火高度必须 ≥4 km；触地侧速 0.7 m/s 满足倾覆判据
L3 防热瓦传热（COMSOL 无头 + 独立差分交叉验证 <1%，见 comsol/tps_tile.java）：再入热流史打进瓦+钢壁叠层，表面峰温 ~1640 K（辐射平衡主导），3 cm 瓦即让钢壁峰温仅 300 K——火星再入热学温和，瓦厚由地球返回决定
pois.detail_en: Four body flaps hinge along the windward sides: a forward pair near the nosecone and a larger aft pair near the skirt. Entry is flown belly-down, the four flaps differentially trimming pitch and roll until the terminal flip to vertical for the landing burn. Shown in landing state, flaps slightly drooped; hinge lines are faired.
sim_en: L2 entry corridor (2-DOF lifting body, scripts/sim_entry_veh_rocket_01.py): direct entry at 5.7 km/s admits flight-path angles of only [-13, -12] deg (shallower skips out, steeper exceeds 5 g0) - far narrower and steeper than Earth; nominal -13 deg peaks at 4.9 g0 and 376 kW/m2 stagnation heating (the TPS load case)

L2 flip maneuver (3-DOF pitch + closed-loop TVC, scripts/sim_flip_veh_rocket_01.py): 85 deg to vertical in 3.6 s, losing 1.4 km of altitude and 379 m sideways -> ignition must come at >= 4 km; touchdown lateral velocity 0.7 m/s meets the tip-over criterion

L3 TPS conduction (headless COMSOL cross-checked <1% against an independent finite-difference model, comsol/tps_tile.java): the entry heat-flux history into the tile+steel stack peaks the surface at ~1640 K (radiation-balance dominated), and 3 cm of tile keeps the steel wall at just 300 K - Mars entry is thermally mild; tile thickness is sized by Earth return

pois.label: 乘员段（四层甲板）
pois.detail: 前隔框以上四层：货舱层（ECLSS 机柜 + 货运托盘）、居住层（圆筒气闸 + 厨房 + 餐桌）、铺位层（4 个睡眠舱，床头对准舷窗带）、驾驶层（环形驾驶台 + 观景窗）。中央通行井配安全橙爬梯贯通四层,层高刻意对齐外部舱门 36.8 m、舷窗带 40.5 m、观景窗 42.6 m。

specs.气闸: 圆筒 + 手轮闸门（居住层）

pois.detail_en: Four decks above the forward bulkhead: cargo (ECLSS racks and pallets), habitation (cylindrical airlock, galley, mess table), berthing (4 sleep pods, headboards on the porthole band), and the flight deck (ring console and observation windows). A central well with a safety-orange ladder runs through all four; deck heights deliberately align with the external hatch at 36.8 m, the porthole band at 40.5 m and the observation windows at 42.6 m.

pois.label: 着陆腿（6 展开）
pois.detail: 尾裙周向 6 条展开式着陆腿,主撑 + 副撑三角构型,末端大脚垫分散接地压力应对火星松散风化层。裙部有收放铰整流罩。当前为落地展开状态,脚垫贴地 y=0。

specs.构型: 主撑 + 副撑 + 脚垫

sim: L2 倾覆判据（刚体绕下坡支撑边翻转，见 scripts/sim_tipover_veh_rocket_01.py）：载货态 CG 26m，静态坡度极限 11°，建议着陆场坡度 <7°
L2 动态：载货态平地临界触地侧速 2.0 m/s，8°坡降到 0.6 m/s；典型残余 1~3 m/s → 陡坡(>8°)裕度不足，倾覆是着陆主约束
空载返回态 CG 19m、坡度极限 16° 稳得多；绑定工况是载货到达那一次
pois.detail_en: Six deployable legs around the aft skirt, each a main strut + brace triangle ending in a wide foot pad that spreads bearing load on loose Martian regolith. Fold-out hinges are faired into the skirt. Shown deployed, pads on the ground at y=0.
sim_en: L2 tip-over criterion (rigid body pivoting about the downhill support edge, scripts/sim_tipover_veh_rocket_01.py): laden CG at 26 m gives a static slope limit of 11 deg; recommended landing-site slope < 7 deg

L2 dynamics: laden on flat ground the critical touchdown lateral velocity is 2.0 m/s, dropping to 0.6 m/s on an 8-deg slope; typical residuals run 1-3 m/s -> steep slopes (>8 deg) leave no margin, tip-over is the binding landing constraint
Empty return config (CG 19 m, slope limit 16 deg) is far more stable; the binding case is the laden arrival
